title: Puharich witnesses UFOs alongside Uri Geller

tellings.quote: Puharic himself witnessed UFOs in conjunction with Ariel as well as synchronicities

plain: Andrija Puharich, a physician and researcher of psychic phenomena, is said to have seen UFOs himself while working with Uri Geller, the Israeli performer famed for bending spoons, along with strange coincidences. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD in parapsychology, tells Michels this as something Puharich reported in the 1970s. If true, it would tie Geller's claimed powers to UFO activity.
